name: Sinan Pasha Mosque
text: The Sinan Pasha Mosque (Arabic: جَامِع سنان باشا, romanized: Jāmiʿ Sinān Bāšā) or Al-Sinaniyya Mosque (Arabic: جَامِع السِّنَانِيَّة, romanized: Jāmiʿ as-Sinānīyah) is an early Ottoman-era mosque in Damascus, Syria, located along Suq Sinaniyya Street.

depictions.name: Sinan Pasha Mosque
depictions.text: The Pasha Mosque was a large mosque located in the poor district of Damascus during the Third Crusade.
